title: LeaverReview
description: The review of a leaver's personal knowledge layer (E4.2). While open, the layer is frozen. The decider merges chosen entries as a proposal, keeps the layer for one more period, or purges it; without a decision it is purged at the deadline.

outcome.description: closed: merged (chosen entries proposed, the rest purged), purged, expired (purged at the deadline), cancelled (rehired; the layer is unfrozen) or empty (nothing to review).

decider.description: The deciding identity; absent when any privacy officer decides.

kept.description: The decider already extended the deadline once.

proposalId.description: merged: the proposal the chosen entries became.

entries.description: Only on GET of one review, to its decider: the leaver's personal entries.
